summary: Full backend + frontend regression after MongoDB Atlas swap and UI bug fixes. Backend: 44/44 pytest PASS against user's Atlas cluster. GET /api/health OK; login admin/manager/employee OK; /api/dashboard/stats returns non-zero (total=6, available=4, allocated=1, under_maintenance=1); /api/assets returns 6 seeded assets. Full regression covers auth (login/logout/me/refresh/register/brute-force lockout/forgot-password no-leak/google-invalid), org (dept & category admin-only, promote), assets CRUD + filters + duplicate tag 400, allocation (double 409 + return), transfer (approve/reject/RBAC), booking (overlap 409, non-bookable 400, cancel), maintenance lifecycle (approve->under_maintenance, resolve->available), dashboard/activity/notifications, RBAC sweep, uploads + signed URLs. Frontend Playwright at 1440x900 + 390x844: (1) Date input fix VERIFIED — typing 2026-08-15 into alloc-expected-return persists in the input.value after fill (previously ISO datetime cleared it). (2) Dialog scroll fix VERIFIED — assets Register dialog and audit New-cycle dialog both computed max-height:810px overflow-y:auto; assets-create-submit reachable via scroll_into_view. (3) Mobile drawer VERIFIED — sidebar aside starts at x=-256 (off-screen), mobile-menu-toggle visible & clickable, opens sidebar + mobile-sidebar-backdrop; clicking nav-assets closes drawer and navigates; clicking backdrop area (x>256) closes drawer. (4) Button visibility VERIFIED — dashboard-quick-register (black-on-white), dashboard-quick-book/maintenance (white-on-white/[0.04]), reports-export-csv (white-on-transparent), reports-export-pdf (black-on-white), logout-button visible in user menu with white text. (5) Horizontal overflow at 390px: 7/8 routes clean; /allocation has 20px overflow because the Tabs list (Active/Overdue/Transfers/All history) is 394px wide and the transfer/allocation history table is 650px — table lives in an overflow-x-auto container so it doesn't leak to document, but the tab bar itself doesn't wrap. Minor.

issues: Tab list (4 tabs) is 394px wide vs 390px viewport -> ~20px horizontal document overflow. Consider `flex-wrap` or `overflow-x-auto` on the TabsList, or shortening labels (e.g. drop counts on mobile).

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: On /allocation, wrap the TabsList in an overflow-x-auto container or make labels shorter at <sm so the tab bar doesn't push document width to 410px at 390px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB Atlas MONGO_URL in /app/backend/.env includes credentials in plaintext — expected in this preview environment but flag for prod hardening (use secret manager).

Allocation.js expected_return storage as YYYY-MM-DD (fixed): confirmed input round-trips correctly and backend receives ISO on submit — verified allocations POST accepts and asset transitions correctly (44/44 tests green).
DialogContent now `max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)]` — good; ensures mobile dialogs fit and scroll. Tested asset-register + audit-new-cycle.

Layout.js mobile drawer uses translate-x transition + backdrop z=40; verified body scroll lock works. Backdrop click handler is on the outermost div, so clicking at x < 256 (over sidebar) is intercepted by sidebar itself — this is correct behavior, sidebar clicks shouldn't close the drawer.
TabsList on /allocation is not responsive at 390px — fixes-worthy but low priority since only 20px overflow and the page is still usable.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all core flows PASS; one minor 20px tab overflow on /allocation @ 390px)
